snippet.title: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Uncanny Tales: The Watcher trailer for this upcoming episodic horror game. 2006. You become the new reserve caretaker. Patrol the territory in your rugged 4x4, check the phototraps, and monitor the area using surveillance cameras. But remember: you are not the only one watching. Uncanny Tales: The Watcher will be available on PC on August 6, 2026.
